root_cause.text: The `l2tp_xmit_core` function in the L2TP subsystem fails to validate that the calculated UDP encapsulated packet length does not exceed the 16-bit maximum value (65535) before assigning it to the UDP header length field.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (udp_len > U16_MAX)` in `net/l2tp/l2tp_core.c` immediately before `uh->len = htons(udp_len);`, addressing the CVE description which explicitly states "l2tp_xmit_core doesn't check for overflows when it assigns the UDP length field."
